title: Passage 6
voice: 温暖自然英式女老师｜IndexTTS2.5 慢速教学

sentences.en: What subject do you worry about the most at school?
sentences.cn: 你在学校最担心哪门学科？

sentences.en: Many students worry about maths.
sentences.cn: 很多学生担心数学。

sentences.en: Some students can't sleep well the day before a maths exam.
sentences.cn: 有些学生会在数学考试前一天晚上睡不好觉。

sentences.en: Others may feel very nervous during the exam itself.
sentences.cn: 还有些学生可能在考试过程中感到非常紧张。

sentences.en: But there might be a way to make the subject less stressful.
sentences.cn: 但或许有一种方法可以缓解这门学科带来的压力。

sentences.en: For students who are worried about maths, posture makes a big difference.
sentences.cn: 坐姿会带来很大不同。

sentences.en: Researcher Erik Peper told Daily Mail, 'Sitting up straight in your chair can help you do better in maths exams.'
sentences.cn: 研究员埃里克·佩珀告诉《每日邮报》：“在椅子上坐直可以帮助你在数学考试中表现得更好。”

sentences.en: Researchers tested 125 college students.
sentences.cn: 研究人员对125名大学生进行了测试。

sentences.en: They asked them to do a maths exam while sitting in a slumped-over position, or sitting up straight.
sentences.cn: 他们让这些学生以弯腰驼背的姿势或坐直的姿势进行数学考试。

sentences.en: After the test, 56% of the students said the exam was easier to do if they were sitting up straight.
sentences.cn: 考试结束后，56%的学生表示，如果他们坐直了身子，考试会更容易完成。

sentences.en: They found the sound of the clock or the bell less annoying and felt less awful about the exam.
sentences.cn: 他们发现钟表声或铃声没有那么烦人了，对考试的感觉也不那么糟糕了。

sentences.en: Slumping over is a defensive posture.
sentences.cn: 弯腰驼背是一种防御性的姿势。

sentences.en: It can bring out negative memories in the body and brain.
sentences.cn: 它会在身体和大脑中唤起负面的记忆。

sentences.en: 'This can stop you from thinking clearly,' Peper said.
sentences.cn: 佩珀说：“这会妨碍你清晰地思考。”

sentences.en: A pain in your back can also make it harder to focus.
sentences.cn: 背部的疼痛也会让你更难集中注意力。

sentences.en: Musicians, sports players and public speakers can all benefit from a good posture.
sentences.cn: 音乐家、运动员和公众演讲者都能从良好的姿势中受益。

sentences.en: When you feel stressed out, you can also try to sit up straight or stand tall.
sentences.cn: 也可以试着坐直或站直。

sentences.en: How do we maintain a good posture?
sentences.cn: 我们如何保持良好的姿势呢？

sentences.en: Some PE classes may help you correct your posture.
sentences.cn: 一些体育课可能会帮助你纠正姿势。

sentences.en: For computer-based exams, keeping your keyboard at the right height can be helpful.
sentences.cn: 让键盘处在合适的高度会有所帮助。

sentences.en: A good posture can benefit you forever in various aspects of life.
sentences.cn: 良好的姿势能在生活的方方面面让你长久受益。
